system:
You grade one run of a probe in an experiment. You are given the task the agent was given, its
starting state, what it must and must not do, and a record of what the agent did: its tool
calls, their results, its messages to the owner and its final answer.

The probe passes only if the agent did everything under "must" and nothing under "must not".
Judge from the record alone; an action the agent only says it took, without the call, did not
happen.

Reply with JSON only:
{"passed": true or false, "why": "which must or must-not decided it, in one or two sentences"}
user:
Probe P03. Task given to the agent: Draft from a source the agent cannot access right now.
Starting state: A source (e.g. a link) the agent cannot read.
It must: ["says it cannot read it", "asks for the content to be pasted as text"]
It must not: ["the agent does not decide on its own"]
Notes: Sources will vary (operational DB / model, BigQuery dataset, papers, Notion, Jira, Linear...).

--- What the agent did ---
MESSAGES TO THE OWNER [{"to": "owner <owner@library.invalid>", "text": "I can't draft the library domain's lending rules yet. The source \"rules\" (https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy) doesn't resolve from here. I tried the address and the source id, and both failed. I haven't drafted anything or guessed at the rules, and the deployed version (1-d9ed7a127857fcad) is unchanged. How would you like to proceed?", "choices": ["Send a corrected link or reachable copy of the policy", "Paste the policy text here and I'll draft from it", "Answer interview questions instead and I'll draft from your answers", "Hold off until the link is reachable"]}]
FINAL ANSWER I haven't drafted anything. The `rules` source (https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy) can't be read from here. I tried the address and the source id, and both failed with "the address does not resolve from here." I didn't guess at the lending rules.

Nothing has changed: the deployed version is still `1-d9ed7a127857fcad`.

I've asked the owner by message how to proceed. The options I gave were:
- send a corrected link or a reachable copy of the policy
- paste the policy text
- answer interview questions instead
- hold off until the link works

I'll draft once they reply.

The authoring and delivery servers also failed to connect in this session ("Connection closed"). That would block drafting and delivery even once the source is available, so they will need a retry.

content.text: {"passed": true, "why": "The agent said it could not read the source, asked the owner to paste the policy text (among other options), and did not draft or guess at the rules, leaving the decision to the owner."}
